about: DigiSwarm 0.2 for Digitone OS 1.43 and 1.44: the author's released .elemod files, pinned unchanged.

mods.title: DigiSwarm
mods.summary: An effects engine for the audio inputs: eleven engines with four variations, a 60-second looper, Hold, Reverse and MIDI CCs, on a page like the Digitone's own. With fxkit (0.2): a mixer, two LFOs on the stock LFO page aimed at its controls, p-locks kept in the pattern, and the MIDI tracks editable while it plays. The synths are silent while it is the active effect.
mods.description: An effects engine for the Digitone mk1's audio inputs: eleven engines (SHARDS, SEQ, GLIDE, MIST, DRONE, RAKE, CHOPS, STUTTER, ARP, PATTERN, WARP) with four variations each, a 60-second looper with overdub and undo, Hold, Reverse, a resonant filter, pitch modulation and a reverb with four rooms, in time with the Digitone's tempo, and MIDI CCs for its controls and looper. DIGISWARM in core-dn1's Mod Menu (hold a track key) makes it the active effect and opens its page; while it is active it owns the audio engine (the synths are muted), through fxkit's MIXER (AMP), with two LFOs aimed at its controls (LFO) and p-locks on the pattern's steps (RECORD: hold a trig, turn a control; Hold, Reverse and the engine lock too). MIDI leaves the page to edit the MIDI tracks while it plays; NO turns it off. Needs fxkit (core-dn1 4.1).
mods.author: irpina
mods.on_unit: 0.2 tested on a Digitone mk1 by its author (Oct 2026), built before the effects' rename, which changed only names; still a beta. Also checked in digikit's emulator on OS 1.43 and 1.44. Not yet run on a Digitone Keys.
